title: Exorcist 98 Field Report: triage of every high and critical finding
method: Each repository with a high or critical finding was downloaded again at the pinned commit and re-scanned with the same scanner build (all 895 findings reproduced exactly). For every finding the flagged line and the lines around it were read; base64 blobs were decoded and read; repeated patterns (one blob split over many lines, the same placeholder in many translated copies of a doc) were read once per file and the decision applied to every finding in that file. Secret values are never recorded here.

labelsMean.true-positive: The finding points at something a security reviewer should act on: the threat the rule describes is really there.
labelsMean.debatable: The text really does what the rule describes (for example a working injection payload, or a remote script piped into a shell in an agent setup), but in context it is deliberate, openly labelled or low risk. Reasonable reviewers could disagree.
labelsMean.false-positive: The rule matched, but the threat it describes does not apply (placeholder, quoted example, data, formatting).
